ghibli_textures.source: the cartoon pass's albedo of each set (its shapes and mean colour carry over), seeded with three-way brush-stroke noise

ghibli_skies.source: each stage's photographed sky (the night city's own painted dome): its cloud layout as cream cumulus over a clear afternoon gradient, repainted as Oga gouache with towering cumulus; recipes per sky in the manifest

ghibli_flat.source: each set painted from its palette (flat gouache washes cut by quantile from broad noise pushed by brush strokes); params per set in the manifest

riders.source: SDF figures (cartoon/riders/figures.py) meshed by the flagman's toon pipeline: marching cubes, QEM, projection, material cuts, baked AO

ghibli_backdrops.source: each stage's far and mid distance: a procedural periodic silhouette over the stage's sky horizon colour, painted as Oga gouache by SDXL img2img with circular padding; recipes per strip in the manifest

ghibli_bake.source: each big prop's flat-shaded model rendered from five views, each view repainted as Oga gouache by SDXL img2img and projected back into one UV atlas per LOD; recipes per model in the manifest
